attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca), signed the host's ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub (principals: node1, NODE_IP, localhost), and configured sshd via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-ssh-ca-cert.conf to present it. Verified a client trusting only the CA public key (via an @cert-authority line, with no pinned host key) connects without a host-key warning, per verbose ssh debug output showing 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol on node1: captured a pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued `systemctl reboot`, confirmed the connection dropped, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd health, certificate persistence, and CA-trust-based connection after recovery.
